description: stockPalette.ts exports the stock token map with the same keys and values as server/migrations/utils/templates/_shared/constants.cjs
resolveEmailPalette derives dark, outerBg, footerBg, cardBorder, infoBoxBg, infoBoxBorder, cardShadow, badgeBg and gradient from primary and secondary
resolveEmailPalette in single-color mode (secondary null) derives the gradient end from primary lightened 18%
resolveEmailPalette applies per-token overrides on top of derived values
applyEmailPalette replaces every stock token occurrence, case-insensitively for hex and tolerant of spacing variants in rgba and 'background: #' forms
applyEmailPalette leaves non-palette colors (status ambers, comment-box blues, text grays) untouched
applyEmailPalette rewrites auth templates that use <style> blocks as well as inline-style templates
applyEmailPalette accepts a previously applied token map as 'from' so a re-apply recolors rows the tool wrote earlier
classifyTenantTemplate returns 'system' when no tenant row exists
classifyTenantTemplate returns 'branded' when tenant HTML equals the system HTML with appliedPalette substituted and subjects match
classifyTenantTemplate returns 'customized' with a differs hint listing colors, text and/or subject
classifyTenantTemplate returns 'no-stock-colors' when the tenant HTML contains no stock or applied tokens
suggestEmailPalette returns customTheme.light primary/secondary with source 'custom-theme' when a custom theme is configured
suggestEmailPalette returns the CUSTOM_THEME_PRESETS light primary/secondary with source 'theme-pair' when a non-default pair is picked
suggestEmailPalette returns branding primary/secondary with source 'portal-branding' when only client portal colors are set
suggestEmailPalette returns the stock palette with source 'default' otherwise
the default 'alga' pair does not count as a picked theme for suggestion purposes
saveEmailBrandingAction persists settings.emailBranding under withAuth with settings:update
saveEmailBrandingAction rejects malformed hex values
saveEmailBrandingAction strips logo and hideAttribution on Community
getEmailBrandingStatusAction returns saved palette, suggestion with source, and per-template classification for the tenant's languages
getEmailBrandingStatusAction lists system template names newer than appliedAt with no tenant row
applyEmailBrandingAction inserts branded clones for 'system' selections with system_template_id set
applyEmailBrandingAction updates 'branded' rows by rewriting from appliedPalette to the new map
applyEmailBrandingAction rewrites ticked 'customized' rows replacing only stock/applied tokens
applyEmailBrandingAction skips unticked customized rows and no-stock-colors rows and reports them
applyEmailBrandingAction returns written/skipped/failed with per-row reasons
applyEmailBrandingAction records appliedAt and appliedPalette after success
applyEmailBrandingAction batches inserts and updates per language inside a transaction
removeEmailBrandingAction deletes only rows classified branded and clears appliedAt
Email branding card renders above the language filter on the Email templates tab with id email-branding-card
panel prefills primary/secondary from the suggestion and shows a source chip naming the source
panel shows 'Saved' chip and a 'Use suggested colors' link when a saved palette differs from the suggestion
single-color toggle hides the secondary input and switches derivation
derived tokens render as read-only swatches with an Adjust disclosure exposing each as an overridable color
two preview iframes re-render from system template HTML with the draft palette on every change, with no server writes
Save palette persists via saveEmailBrandingAction and registers with UnsavedChangesProvider while dirty
'Apply to templates' opens apply-email-branding-dialog with language checkboxes defaulting to the tenant's languages
dialog groups templates by state: system and branded preselected, customized unchecked with differs hint, no-stock-colors disabled
select all / none per group and a live count in the confirm button
confirm calls applyEmailBrandingAction and replaces the table with a written/skipped/failed summary including per-row reasons
template list refreshes after apply so branded rows show as customized in the existing table
edit dialog shows 'Apply my palette' (apply-palette-to-template) when a palette is saved, disabled otherwise
clicking it rewrites the editor HTML client-side from stock/applied tokens to the saved palette without saving
Customize (clone) on a template starts from the branded HTML when a palette is saved
banner on the Email templates tab lists the count of system templates added since appliedAt without tenant rows
banner button opens the scope dialog with only those templates preselected
banner dismiss hides it for the session and it returns when the count changes
Enterprise section renders logo switch, variant picker and attribution switch only when edition is Enterprise
variant picker offers only uploaded variants, preferring wide, with a link to Client Portal branding when none exist
apply inserts a data-alga-brand-logo in the header cell of layout templates and before the first heading in auth templates
re-apply replaces an existing data-alga-brand-logo image instead of adding a second
apply with hideAttribution removes 'Powered by AlgaPSA' and its separator in both footer variants
re-enabling attribution restores the system footer for branded rows
server strips logo and hideAttribution on Community even if present in the saved palette
all new strings live under notifications.emailBranding.* in msp/settings for every shipped locale
nineminds docs: email section added to themes-and-white-label and apply flow added to the email templates doc
